note: X is not polled. These rows are public UKMTO warnings copied from ukmto.org, plus the X status URL for warning 199-26. Coordinates are not stored. The server geocodes only a named place in the text.

items.headline: UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 8NM northwest of Khasab, Oman.
items.summary: Military authorities reported the Tanker is on fire which has resulted in the evacuation of the crew. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate. Incident date 07 Nov 2026, 1920 UTC. Wording from UKMTO warning 199-26.
items.editorNote: Warning text is the 8 Nov 2026 UKMTO PDF. The X status clock time is not stored because this app does not call the X API. publishedAt is the warning date.

items.headline: UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
items.summary: The Company Security Officer of a tanker has reported that the vessel was struck by an unknown projectile while transiting outbound through the Strait of Hormuz. All crew are safe and accounted for and there is no reported environmental impact at this time. UKMTO warning 200-26. Incident date 07 Nov 2026, 2020 UTC.

items.headline: UKMTO reported an explosion at the waterline, port side, approx. 16 NM east of Khasab, Oman.
items.summary: On 05 Nov the Master of a tanker transiting outbound reported an explosion at the waterline. The crew reported safe, and the vessel continued its voyage. UKMTO 197-26, from the JMIC advisory of 08 Nov 2026.

items.headline: UKMTO reported a bulk carrier disabled approx. 18 NM east of Khor Fakkan, UAE.
items.summary: On 07 Nov a vessel identified by US CENTCOM as the HUDA was disabled by military forces in the Gulf of Oman. UKMTO 198-26, from the JMIC advisory of 08 Nov 2026.

items.headline: UKMTO reported an attack on a tanker approx. 72 NM east of Ras Al Khafji.
items.summary: The 01 Nov attack on a tanker approx. 72 NM east of Ras Al Khafji is UKMTO 192-26, cited in the JMIC advisory of 08 Nov 2026.

items.headline: UKMTO reported an attack on a tanker approx. 50 NM north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar.
items.summary: The 04 Nov attack on a tanker approx. 50 NM north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar is UKMTO 196-26, cited in the JMIC advisory of 08 Nov 2026.
